title: Escalation classifier before asking Nolan (grill-20 as a gate)
failure: The grill-20 escalation classifier exists as a locked directive; agents still escalate by gut feel. The classifier (locked invariant? previous decision? code evidence? reversible experiment? 80% safe default? no consequential effects?) is not a gate.
invariant: No question reaches Nolan without a classifier record showing why it could not be decided at 80%.
capability: classifier checklist plus escalation record
test_proof: A week of escalations audited: every one carries a classifier record; questions that failed the classifier were answered without Nolan.
product_value: Nolan's attention is the scarcest resource in the system. The classifier spends it only where it is irreplaceable.

title: One-tap approval bundles for every human-only action class
failure: Only the device/tunnel approval has the one-tap bundle pattern. Every other human-only action (logins, 2FA, installs, merges) is a bespoke interruption with no standard evidence pack.
invariant: Every human-only action class has a bundle template: what, why, risk, expiry, one action, auto-rollback.
capability: bundle template generalized from the tunnel pattern
test_proof: Each action class has a template; a human asked without a bundle is a process violation.
product_value: Human gates stay human but cost seconds instead of context switches. Nolan's attention is spent, not drained.

title: Self-healing evidence emission standard for all watchdogs
failure: Watchdogs act (restarts, alerts) but emit inconsistent evidence; the tripwire incident was diagnosed from prose logs, not structured records. No standard says what a supervisor must record.
invariant: Every supervisor action emits TRIGGER, OBSERVATION, DIAGNOSIS, ACTION, CAPABILITY, BEFORE, AFTER, VERIFICATION as a typed record.
capability: evidence schema for supervisors
test_proof: Replay the September tripwire incident from emitted records alone: diagnosis reproducible without reading prose logs.
product_value: Incident review becomes replay, not archaeology. Every future fault is diagnosable from its own evidence.

title: Clean-checkout replay gate for all lanes (the ask-lane lesson)
failure: The 2026-09-26 ask-lane falsification proved the class: committed tests importing uncommitted modules report green in the lane and zero from clean checkout. No gate requires a clean-checkout replay before a lane closes.
invariant: No lane closes on its own report; a clean-checkout replay must execute its tests green, verified by an independent replay.
capability: worktree-based replay procedure
test_proof: A lane with an uncommitted dependency fails the replay gate; the ask-lane recovery (92/92 from clean checkout) is the reference pass.
product_value: Ends the 'green in the lane, red in reality' class. Verifiers decide truth, not lane self-reports.

title: Confidence classification for proposals (act vs escalate with evidence)
failure: Agents either act or ask with no calibrated middle: proposals do not carry confidence, so Nolan cannot tell a 95% safe default from a 55% guess.
invariant: Every proposal carries a confidence class and the evidence behind it; below-threshold confidence escalates with the uncertainty named.
capability: confidence rubric (evidence strength, reversibility, blast radius)
test_proof: Sample of past proposals re-scored: high-confidence ones would have acted correctly, low-confidence ones would have escalated with the right question.
product_value: Nolan's 80% rule becomes operational: agents decide at 80, ask one crisp question below, and the question names the uncertainty.

title: Proposal schema v1 (action, reversibility, blast radius, rollback, evidence)
failure: Proposals are free text; reviewers must reconstruct reversibility, blast radius, and rollback from prose. The Jev contract work proved typed schemas work; proposals have none.
invariant: Every L3 proposal is a typed record: action, level, reversibility, blast radius, rollback plan, evidence refs, confidence.
capability: schema plus validation
test_proof: Malformed proposal (missing rollback) is rejected by the validator before reaching a human.
product_value: Review becomes fast because the safety case is structured. Nolan reads the fields that matter, not paragraphs.

title: Desired-state declarations for every supervised component
failure: Supervision today is per-service scripts with implicit desired state. Nothing declares, in one place, what 'healthy' means per component.
invariant: Every supervised component has a declaration: service identity, endpoint, health contract, restart authority, evidence format.
capability: declaration schema plus per-component files
test_proof: A new component onboarded by writing a declaration alone: the supervisor picks it up and manages it correctly.
product_value: Onboarding a service to supervision becomes writing a declaration, not writing a watchdog. Supervision scales.

title: L1 authority: restart a bounded dev process without asking
failure: Restarting a dev-scoped process currently waits on a human or a bespoke decision, even though the action is reversible, observable, and testable.
invariant: Bounded dev processes (dev servers, watchers) restart on L1 authority: observe, restart via the authorized script, verify, log.
blast_radius: Dev processes only; shared services excluded.
capability: L1 action class plus authorized restart scripts
test_proof: Kill a dev server: it restarts via the authorized script and serves within the SLO, with an audit record and no human involved.
product_value: The smallest autonomy win, repeated daily: dev loops never wait on a human for a restart.

title: L1 authority: rerun deterministic tests and repair generated fixtures without asking
failure: Rerunning a deterministic suite or regenerating a generated fixture waits on a human decision, though both are fully reversible and verifiable.
invariant: Deterministic test reruns and generated-fixture repairs are L1: run, compare, log; canonical fixtures are never touched without a proposal.
blast_radius: Test suite and generated fixtures; canonical fixtures excluded by role (D-01).
capability: L1 action class plus fixture-role awareness
test_proof: Corrupt a generated fixture: the L1 path regenerates it and the suite returns green; touching a canonical fixture is refused.
product_value: Test hygiene without human babysitting: the suite stays green by itself.

title: Refusal coverage battery for unsupported claims
failure: STEP-04 proved refusal for 'holiday hours Thanksgiving 2027' and suitability inference, but coverage is ad hoc: two cases, not a battery. New claim classes can slip through unrefused.
invariant: A standing battery of unsupported-claim probes (temporal, comparative, suitability, off-evidence) all refuse with answerClass unknown and zero citations.
capability: probe battery pattern from the refusal lesson
test_proof: Each probe asserts refusal plus 'I do not have evidence for that' semantics; a new answer path must pass the battery.
product_value: A concierge that hallucinates once loses the owner's trust forever. The battery makes refusal systematic.

title: Deploy the fyd-3100-monitor (design exists, deployment does not)
failure: ~/workspace/fyd-3100-monitor/ has DESIGN.md and fyd-3100-probe.sh (host/network/liveness/readiness/serving probes); per the design doc, deployment was NOT done. The :3100 service is probed by nothing.
invariant: :3100 is continuously probed for liveness, readiness, and serving; failures alert with the probe evidence attached.
capability: deploy the existing probe design
test_proof: Stop :3100: assert the monitor fires with liveness/readiness/serving evidence; restart via start-3100.sh: assert recovery is recorded.
product_value: The demo stack's most important service is currently unmonitored. This closes that gap with already-written code.

title: One-tap approval bundle pattern generalized to all human-only auth asks
failure: The device/tunnel one-tap bundle (AGENTS.md) proved the pattern: pre-verified bundles, 5-minute approval, auto-rollback. Instagram/TikTok login, 2FA, and GitHub App installs have no equivalent; each is a bespoke interruption.
invariant: Every human-only auth ask arrives as a one-tap bundle: what, why, risk, expiry, and one action.
capability: bundle template from the tunnel pattern
test_proof: Each auth category has a bundle template; an ask without the bundle fields is rejected as malformed before reaching Nolan.
product_value: Legitimate human gates stay human but stop costing 20 minutes of context each. One tap, then back to work.

title: Semantic-invariant monitor sweep: replace incidental monitors with identity, ownership, and health
failure: The gateway incident proved the class: the tripwire grepped argv spelling while the healthy service ran under a different argv. PID checks, filename checks, fixed image tags, stale pins, and hardcoded digests are the same defect wearing different clothes.
invariant: Every monitor asserts semantic identity (what it is), ownership (who holds its resources), and health (does it answer); no monitor asserts incidental spelling.
capability: monitor audit plus rewrite to the identity/ownership/health pattern
test_proof: For each monitor: change the incidental property (argv spelling, PID, filename) while keeping the service healthy; assert the monitor stays green. Kill the service: assert it goes red.
product_value: Ends the entire false-red class. Every future service can be supervised without ever repeating September's incident.

title: Recurring bounded harvest process (search, catalog, benchmark, integrate-if-wins)
failure: Harvesting happens in heroic bursts (Hex principles, design baseline). There is no standing process, so commodity work gets reinvented between bursts.
invariant: A bounded harvest runs on cadence: SEARCH PING, search deps, search ecosystem, dedup, propose reuse, benchmark, integrate only on proof, test, record.
capability: harvest procedure with the four-question filter (remove commodity work, improve product loop, improve autonomy, preserve optionality)
test_proof: Each harvest run produces a dated record: candidates, benchmark results, integrate-or-catalog decisions with reasons.
product_value: Turns harvesting from heroics into a habit. Negative LOC becomes a metric, not an accident.

title: WHY THIS lightweight for owners (Correct/Hide)
failure: Why-this drill-down exists (STEP-05) but the owner-facing surface is heavy: value -> field -> method -> source URL. The directive wants: 'Emergency Plumbing. Why this? Found on your Services page and structured website data. [Correct] [Hide].'
invariant: Every rendered business fact offers a one-line why plus Correct/Hide wired to the patch loop.
blast_radius: UI surface; patch loop already exists.
capability: why-this renderer + patch-loop wiring
test_proof: Rendered service shows why-line; Hide proposes a patch, approves, and the service disappears from all projections with an undo path.
product_value: This is the product: confidence without ceremony. Owners correct facts in one tap instead of filing tickets.

title: Failure to lesson loop as a tracked workflow (FAILURE_LEDGER.md is the ledger, the loop is the machine)
failure: Failures are recorded in FAILURE_LEDGER.md but the loop (evidence -> diagnosis -> patch -> test -> reusable lesson -> verify lesson holds) is informal. The nine archaeology failures each produced a lesson by luck of attention, not by process.
invariant: Every significant failure enters the loop and exits as a verified reusable lesson (test, tripwire, type, schema, policy, or recipe).
capability: loop procedure plus lesson verification
test_proof: Each of the nine archaeology failures maps to its lesson artifact; new failures follow the same path within the sprint.
product_value: Failures become assets automatically. The system gets smarter per incident instead of per hero.

title: Fixture role manifest (generated vs canonical, machine-enforced)
failure: FL-20260921-034: six tests failed because regenerated fixtures silently replaced canonical ones (happy-place 2 objects vs 9 in HEAD). Roles were separated by hand afterward, but nothing enforces the separation.
invariant: Every fixture declares its role in a manifest; generated fixtures can never be consumed where a canonical fixture is required, enforced by a loader check.
capability: manifest file plus loader assertion
test_proof: Swap a generated fixture into a canonical slot: loader throws with the role mismatch named; CI fails.
product_value: Kills the fixture-role confusion class permanently; test failures mean real regressions, not fixture drift.

title: Fix ask-pipeline dangling site-bundle import (snapshot drift)
failure: ask-pipeline.ts imports @/fyd/media/site-bundle, which does not exist in the fyd-product-lane snapshot tree; the lane copy lives at ~/workspace/fyd-ask-graph-read/site-bundle.ts. Snapshot drift means the ask path cannot be replayed from this tree.
invariant: Every committed import resolves inside the same tree; snapshot drift is detected by CI, not by humans.
capability: commit the module tree with the tests (standing lesson from the 2026-09-26 ask-lane recovery)
test_proof: Clean-checkout import closure test: every module imported by the ask pipeline resolves; suite runs green from a fresh worktree.
product_value: A pipeline that cannot be replayed from a clean checkout cannot be trusted, fixed, or handed off.

title: Read-only discovery pool widening as a standard L2 operation
failure: Same root as S-05, operationalized: there is no standard procedure for widening discovery, so each widening is a bespoke decision.
invariant: Widening a read-only discovery pool follows a checklist (scope, reversibility, no-contact guarantee) and needs no human.
capability: checklist plus configuration change procedure
test_proof: Checklist run produces an audit record; a widening that touches contact configuration fails the checklist.
product_value: Discovery scales on rails; the never-reengage guard and contact gates stay exactly as strict.

title: 22-dimension critical-bug checklist enforced on patches
failure: The grill-20 22-dimension checklist (input, contract, authority, identity, persistence, transaction, retry, restart, replay, projection, tenant, privacy, authorization, cache, search/vector, serialization, UI, observability, test, deployment, rollback, memory) exists as a directive; nothing enforces it on actual patches.
invariant: Every critical-bug patch records which of the 22 dimensions it touches and why the others are untouched.
capability: checklist template plus patch-record convention
test_proof: Sample of past patches re-checked: the checklist would have caught the unexamined dimensions (e.g., tenant, privacy) before merge.
product_value: Checklists catch what memory misses. Twenty-two dimensions beat one tired reviewer.

title: Negative-LOC reward: track deletion as progress
failure: SOUL 22 says progress means fewer competing authorities, but nothing measures it: LOC only grows, and deletions are invisible in every report.
invariant: Every change reports LOC delta; consolidations that delete code are celebrated with the same visibility as features.
capability: LOC delta in change records plus a deletion ledger
test_proof: A consolidation's record shows negative LOC with capability preserved (tests green); the ledger lists it.
product_value: What gets measured gets done. Rewarding deletion is how the codebase gets smaller and stronger.

title: Determinism CI gate for the generator (STEP-01 as a gate, not a record)
failure: STEP-01 proved specDigest identical across two runs as a one-time record. Nothing runs it per change, so a nondeterministic generator change ships silently.
invariant: Every generator change passes the repeated-generation determinism gate in CI.
capability: STEP-01 procedure as a CI job
test_proof: Introduce a nondeterministic change (Date.now in identity): the gate fails before merge.
product_value: Promotes the determinism proof from a document to a gate.

title: Determinism fail-first tests for the generator (byte-identical repeated generation)
failure: A module-global projectCounter produced identities from mutable process state; the generator was not byte-identical across runs (fixed 2026-09-22 hostile-g2).
invariant: Repeated generation from the same canonical input produces byte-identical output; any nondeterminism fails the test before it ships.
capability: repeated-generation harness from the failure lesson
test_proof: Generate twice from the same input in separate processes: bytes identical, digests equal; injecting Date.now into identity derivation fails the test.
product_value: Deterministic regeneration is the product promise that lets owners trust 'keep it current'. Fail-first tests hold it.

title: Enforce the L0-L4 action matrix in the agent operating model
failure: Agents operate on prose authority ('proposal-only', 'bounded autonomy') with no enforced action levels. The same 'proposal-only' rule covers both a selector fix and a production deployment, which is why review debt accumulates and risky actions have no standard gate.
invariant: Every agent action declares its level; L0-L2 execute, L3 proposes with evidence, L4 requires named human authority; violations are refused by tooling, not by convention.
capability: action-level classifier plus proposal schema
test_proof: Replay of past incidents: the force-kill would classify L2 (recovery path exists), a production deploy L3, key destruction L4; each routes correctly.
product_value: The single highest-leverage autonomy item: it converts every other autonomy improvement from prose into enforceable behavior.

title: Shadow/eval harness for Jev decisions (agreement, grounding, evidence, schema, latency, cost)
failure: Jev moved to serious primary use (2026-09-26) on a contract plus one live canary. There is no standing harness measuring agreement, grounding, evidence quality, schema validity, latency, and cost per decision point.
invariant: Every Jev decision point has a standing eval: agreement vs ground truth, evidence cited, schema valid, latency and cost within budget.
capability: eval harness plus decision-point registry
test_proof: Eval runs per decision point; a point falling below agreement threshold is demoted to shadow automatically.
product_value: Serious use requires serious measurement. The harness is what lets Jev's remit expand without expanding risk.

title: Decision log for Nolan's reversals is the autonomy boundary record
failure: Autonomy boundaries move when Nolan reverses policy, but the moves are scattered across memory and directives. Agents cannot reliably answer 'what am I allowed to do today'.
invariant: The decision log (SI-06) is the single place autonomy boundaries are read from; every L-level definition references it.
capability: log plus reference convention
test_proof: Ask 'may I do X': the answer traces to a dated log entry, not to memory or vibes.
product_value: Autonomy with a readable boundary is safe autonomy. The log is the boundary's source of truth.

title: Closure-aware reconciliation for all gap detectors
failure: reconcile.py re-escalated 10 R2 + 7 R3 gaps across 3+ reports because it ignored closure dispositions; fixed 2026-09-20 with lifecycle OPEN/KNOWN_PERMANENT/RESOLVED/REOPENED. Other detectors were never audited for the same defect.
invariant: Every gap detector consumes closure dispositions as input; suppression is auditable and reopenable.
capability: lifecycle state machine pattern from the 2026-09-20 fix
test_proof: For each detector: feed a closed gap, assert no re-escalation on the next run; reopen the disposition, assert escalation resumes.
product_value: Stops alert fatigue: every repeated false escalation trains operators to ignore the real ones.

title: Tripwire identity, ownership, and health evaluation (done 2026-09-26)
failure: Tripwire trusted argv spelling. Fixed during the incident: evaluates service identity, listener ownership, and health; controlled kill/recovery proof passed.
invariant: Gateway supervision asserts identity, ownership, and health.
capability: already implemented
test_proof: Controlled kill/recovery proof passed 2026-09-26; journal integrity intact; unexpected writers zero.
product_value: Already delivered: the reference implementation of semantic monitoring.

title: Invalid workdir fails before provider dispatch (stop paying for broken launches)
failure: Open reliability item 8: worker launches with invalid workdirs still reach provider dispatch, burning tokens and producing confusing failures.
invariant: Workdir validation is a pre-dispatch gate; invalid workdirs fail locally with a typed error and zero provider calls.
capability: pre-dispatch validation gate
test_proof: Launch with invalid workdir: zero provider calls observed, typed error returned; contract tests cover every refusal path.
product_value: Stops burning money and confusion on launches that were broken before they started.

title: Structured vs messy web parse tiers with truthful extraction stats
failure: The @graph failure taught that parse-tier behavior must be labeled; without per-tier stats, RESOLVE priority cannot behave as documented and silent-empty can recur in a new tier.
invariant: Every extraction records its parse tier and truthful stats (nodes visited, facts produced); zero facts from a successful fetch raises an alert, never a quiet empty.
capability: extraction stats already partially exist; add tier labels and zero-fact alert
test_proof: Fixture page with valid JSON-LD array shape produces tier label plus NODES>0; a page with no extractable content records tier plus explicit zero with reason.
product_value: Makes the @graph invariant permanent: the pipeline can never again silently produce nothing and look fine.

title: Stale wrapper reconstruction automation (Temp volatility)
failure: C:/Windows/Temp is volatile; hermes-run.sh and hermes-launch.py were silently lost, causing exit 127 with empty output. Reconstruction notes exist in INTEGRATION.md but nothing checks wrapper existence before use.
invariant: Every volatile-path dependency has a local reconstruction source and a pre-flight existence check with a clear error naming the reconstruction recipe.
capability: pre-flight check plus reconstruction recipe registry
test_proof: Delete a wrapper: the pre-flight check fails with the recipe name; run the recipe: the wrapper is restored and the call succeeds.
product_value: Turns silent 127s into one-command recoveries. Volatile paths stop being mystery failures.

title: Jev evidence-support classification as primary for Ask FYD
failure: Ask FYD answers are produced by the pipeline's own classification; TYPESAFE_JEV (contract 25/25 green, live canary 2026-09-26) is available for bounded semantic decisions but not yet primary at the answer-evidence seam.
invariant: Every Ask FYD answer carries a Jev-typed evidence class (SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED / UNKNOWN) computed by the bounded semantic path, not by the generator.
blast_radius: Answer classification; Jev remains proposal-only, never authorizes effects.
capability: TYPESAFE_JEV via jev_ask.py (profile-only, purpose gating, budget gate, spend ledger)
test_proof: Shadow/eval harness: Jev classification agreement with ground truth on the 4-case battery (supported/partial/unsupported/conflicting); schema validation on every response.
product_value: Evidence-bounded answers that can prove their support level are the product differentiator against generic chatbots.

title: Friction-to-consequence mapping in the patch loop
failure: Every customization currently goes through the same proposal/approval ceremony. Changing padding should not cost the same ceremony as publishing new pricing everywhere.
invariant: LOW (change heading): apply quickly, undo available. MEDIUM (hide service): preview plus undo. HIGH (publish pricing everywhere): explicit approval. VERY HIGH (message 2,000 people): strong confirmation plus capability and policy checks.
blast_radius: Patch loop UX; authority boundaries unchanged.
capability: consequence classifier (Jev ambiguity triage candidate) + tiered approval paths
test_proof: Matrix test: one action per tier asserting the required approval level; VERY HIGH action without confirmation is refused.
product_value: Removes constitutional ceremony from trivial changes while keeping consequential authority intact. Speed where safe, gates where it matters.

title: Bounded L-level authority for engagement-driver fixes with rollback and green tests
failure: training-curriculum.md:63 leaves driver fixes ambiguous; routine reversible repairs (selector updates, timing tweaks) pile into the morning review queue because proposal-only authority is too coarse.
invariant: Bounded driver fixes (known file, known selector set, green tests before and after, instant rollback) execute without review; everything else proposes.
capability: L-level authority class plus rollback procedure
test_proof: Fix applied, tests green, rollback demonstrated; an out-of-bounds fix (new file, new capability) is refused and proposed instead.
product_value: Kills the morning-review debt queue: the highest-frequency autonomy failure in the social lane.

title: SafeLink type-level enforcement at every render sink
failure: React escaped text but rendered javascript: URLs into href (FL-20260922-002). safe-link.ts exists as a library, but nothing forces render code to use it; a new sink reintroduces the class.
invariant: No href/src/action sink accepts a raw string; all pass through the SafeLink type, enforced by lint plus type checks.
capability: safe-link.ts (241-line equivalent in TS) plus lint rule
test_proof: Hostile-scheme battery (javascript:, data:, vbscript, bounded encoding layers): all fail closed to plain text; a raw-string href fails the lint gate.
product_value: One XSS in a generated business site destroys trust in every site FYD builds. Type enforcement ends the class.

title: Automated PASTE URL to new-tenant site pipeline
failure: Onboarding a new business today is manual operator assembly. POST /api/fyd/onboarding/preview stops at an evidence preview plus an OBSERVED claim; nothing wires preview into runExtractionPipeline, tenant registration, SiteSpec generation, or a served site. Both tenants are hand-pinned fixtures (happy-place-graph.ts, coppersmith-graph.ts).
invariant: PASTE URL -> served generated site with zero operator assembly for the standard case.
blast_radius: New tenants only; existing fixtures untouched.
capability: onboarding finalize endpoint; 9-stage extraction; tenant registry write with digest verification
test_proof: End-to-end: submit a prospect URL, assert a served /sites/[slug] with SiteSpec digest matching the extraction output; fixture tenants byte-identical before/after.
product_value: This is the product loop's first two arrows. Without it every new customer costs operator hours; with it FYD can onboard businesses faster than any manual process.

title: Provenance completeness: every fact carries source URL or content-addressed event id
failure: Why-this fails closed with no provenance, but nothing enforces that ALL facts (not just why-this-surfaced ones) carry provenance. A fact without provenance is an unverifiable claim.
invariant: Fact creation without provenance fails closed at the schema level.
capability: schema constraint on fact records
test_proof: Attempt to create a fact without source: schema rejects; existing facts all carry source URL or event id (audit query returns zero orphans).
product_value: Evidence-bounded answers are only as strong as the weakest fact. This makes 'how do you know' answerable for everything.

title: Re-run canonical jest suite on HEAD; replace the 2026-09-21 195/195 snapshot
failure: The 195/195 figure is a 2026-09-21 snapshot; the tree changed materially on 2026-09-22 (phantom branch loss, ask/* and safe-link.ts rebuilt) and 2026-09-26 (ask-lane recovery 8cc8291). TEST-GATE.md measured 116 on 2026-09-21; the ask lane replayed 92/92 on 2026-09-26. No current number exists.
invariant: The canonical gate number always describes HEAD, measured this week, from a clean worktree.
capability: jest run on clean worktree; TEST-GATE.md updated with date and commit
test_proof: The re-run itself, recorded with commit SHA and date.
product_value: Stale green claims are how regressions hide. A current number restores the gate's authority.

title: Scope exception to the Sept-16 force-kill rule for graceful closes and origin-scoped mutations
failure: The Sept-16 force-kill trauma became a blanket rule: even graceful closes (Ctrl+C) and origin-scoped DOM mutations are gated behind an always-on watchdog. Locks then go stale without a graceful path to free them.
invariant: Graceful close and origin-scoped DOM mutation are always allowed; the watchdog is the recovery path, not a gate.
capability: rule amendment plus lock-staleness recheck
test_proof: Simulate stale lock: graceful close frees it without watchdog intervention; force-kill still triggers watchdog recovery.
product_value: Removes a permanent tax on every browser automation session: no more waiting on Nolan to free a lock a graceful close could have freed.

title: Weekly autonomy metrics (interventions, time-to-green without Nolan)
failure: Autonomy is the program's goal but has no metric: nobody counts human interventions per week or mean time to green without Nolan.
invariant: A weekly report counts human interventions, their categories, and time-to-green with and without Nolan.
capability: intervention logging plus weekly rollup
test_proof: Two consecutive weeks of reports exist with consistent categories; the trend is visible.
product_value: The program's scoreboard. Without it, autonomy is a vibe; with it, it is a number that moves.

title: Media region aspect-ratio stability (no layout shift)
failure: No aspect-ratio or layout-shift discipline exists in the render path; media arriving late shifts content, which the directive explicitly forbids.
invariant: Every media slot declares its aspect ratio up front; cumulative layout shift stays at zero through media load.
capability: aspect-ratio slot contract plus layout-shift measurement
test_proof: Load a page with slow media: assert zero horizontal overflow and layout-shift score below threshold at 320 and 1280.
product_value: Layout shift on a customer's phone reads as broken. Stability reads as professional.

title: Fresh hostile probe re-run against the rebuilt safe-link.ts
failure: The 2026-09-21 hostile probe predates the 2026-09-22 rebuild; safe-link.ts was rewritten during the phantom-branch recovery and never re-probed.
invariant: The rebuilt URL sanitizer passes a fresh hostile battery: schemes, encodings, unicode tricks, bounded decode layers.
capability: hostile battery from the failure lesson
test_proof: Battery runs green against the rebuilt module; any bypass fails closed to plain text.
product_value: A rewritten sanitizer without a re-probe is an unproven sanitizer. The re-run restores proof.

title: Morning-review queue with SLA (proposals never park silently)
failure: Proposal-only authority created a morning review queue with no SLA: proposals park until Nolan looks. A queue with no SLA is a denial of autonomy by delay.
invariant: Every queued proposal has an SLA; expired proposals auto-escalate with a recommendation or execute their safe default, never silently park.
capability: queue with expiry and escalation
test_proof: Proposal parked past SLA: assert it escalated with a recommendation; a safe-default proposal executed and logged.
product_value: Autonomy dies in queues. The SLA guarantees every proposal resolves, with or without Nolan's immediate attention.

title: L2 authority: restart a supervised shared service via its authorized script
failure: Watchdogs already restart :18199 and the gateway autonomously, but :3100 has no supervisor and no L2 authority is declared; restarts are ad hoc.
invariant: :3100 and every shared service has a declared L2 restart authority: which script, which verification, which evidence.
capability: L2 declarations per service (O-04's desired-state loop is the mechanism)
test_proof: Stop :3100: the L2 path restarts it via start-3100.sh, verifies NEXT_PUBLIC_FYD_DEMO_OWNER_MODE=1, and emits evidence.
product_value: Shared services heal without paging anyone. This is the autonomy the incident proved is possible.

title: New-field privacy classification gate (fail closed on unclassified fields)
failure: FYD-010 proved that new fields (phone, home_address) can reach visitor context with only object-level visibility. There is no gate requiring a field-level privacy classification before a new field becomes renderable.
invariant: Any field not present in the visitor-safe allowlist is invisible to visitors; adding a field requires an explicit privacy classification.
blast_radius: Field visibility; safe default is hidden.
capability: schema-level default-deny plus classification checklist
test_proof: Add a field without classification: visitor render omits it and a test fails until the classification exists.
product_value: Privacy must be the default, not a review step. This makes the FYD-010 class structurally impossible.

title: Politeness and budget enforcement for multi-page discovery
failure: Once L3 discovery exists (P-02), nothing stops it from hammering a small business site: no crawl-delay observance, no per-domain concurrency cap beyond the semaphore, no robots handling recorded.
invariant: Discovery declares its budget up front (max pages, max bytes, max seconds, concurrency 1 per domain default) and stops exactly at the budget.
capability: budgets.ts and rate-limit.ts already exist; wire into discovery loop
test_proof: Discovery against a fixture site with 100 pages and budget 10 fetches exactly 10 and reports budget-exhausted, not an error.
product_value: A crawler that hammers a plumber's shared-hosting site is a reputational incident. Budgets make discovery a good guest.

title: Evidence freshness timestamps and staleness surfacing
failure: Facts carry provenance but no freshness signal; a 3-year-old services page and yesterday's re-crawl look identical to Ask FYD and to the owner.
invariant: Every fact carries observed_at; Ask FYD and rendered pages surface staleness where it matters (services, hours, pricing).
capability: observed_at already exists in media plan; extend to facts
test_proof: Fact with observed_at 3 years past renders a staleness badge; Ask FYD cites the date when answering from old evidence.
product_value: Freshness is trust: an owner who sees 'verified 2 days ago from your site' believes the answer.

title: Conflict records first-class (SOURCE SAYS vs OWNER SAYS) with resolution

title: FYD-037 wrong-journal guard (marker checks on emit)
failure: FYD-037 is open: emit() can post to a misconfigured journal without marker verification. A misconfigured journal URL silently becomes the system of record.
invariant: Every emit verifies journal markers before posting; a marker mismatch refuses the write.
blast_radius: Journal emit path; writes refused safely.
capability: marker check on emit
test_proof: Point emit at a wrong journal: refused with the marker mismatch named; correct journal: writes normally.
product_value: The journal is the source of truth. Writing truth to the wrong journal is a silent catastrophe; the guard makes it loud.

title: Conversation memory bounds (continuity without surveillance)
failure: Grill-20 locked: ask continuity must not become permanent surveillance. No bounds exist on what Ask FYD remembers across conversations.
invariant: Ask FYD retains only what the current task needs, with declared retention; nothing is kept 'just in case'.
capability: retention declarations per memory class
test_proof: Audit: list everything retained after a conversation closes; assert each item has a declared retention and purpose.
product_value: Privacy as a feature: owners trust a concierge that forgets what it does not need.
